commit_sha_note: Null at write time, same convention as every prior archive receipt in this campaign: a file cannot declare the hash of the commit that contains it before that commit is made. Recorded by an immediately-following, separate commit that touches only dispatch_queue.json.

synthesis.primary_new_finding: Red Team: shard identity is 100% collinear with batch-size transition regime (N_JACK_BATCHES=200 fixed; shards 5000/6000 both tested at 25->50 transition, both SE-decrease; shards 8001/8002 both tested at 50->100 transition, both SE-increase). A third, previously unnamed, directly falsifiable explanation for the sign-flipping four-shard pattern, distinct from shard-specific and general-heterogeneity.
synthesis.next_actions_adopted: Both Red Team recommendations: confound-breaking cross-regime design, and a null-object control on the 2-point local-exponent diagnostic itself. Further same-regime single-shard data collection judged to have reached diminishing returns.
